doc: The one owner of every Windows PNut compile rule: per suite directory (relative to TEST/), the default PNut flag, the outputs captured as GOLD, per-pattern and per-file flag overrides, hand skips, and header notes. scripts/gold/gen-rebuild-scripts.js writes TEST/<dir>/rebuild-gold.ps1 from it; scripts/fixtures/generate.js reads each suite's default flag from it. Field meanings are documented at the top of gen-rebuild-scripts.js.

Sourced from: src/tests/COV-tests/pnut-ts-cov.test.ts (glob *.spin2, filters
out *__pre.spin2). The pattern overrides are the test's
{debug_,isp_,coverage_debug_}* rule. coverage_clock_003.spin2 uses debug()
but does not match the prefix pattern (from the existing v52 .ps1).
NOTE: coverage_003_v44.spin2 does NOT get -cd here (it has no debug() call
and does not match any -cd pattern above, so it falls through to the
-DefaultFlag "-c"). Its committed v55 GOLD (153de2f) was built -c: no DEBUG
data/records section, 332 OBJ bytes. The .test.ts previously passed pnut-ts
flag -44 (force compile-as-v44) for this file; that flag has never existed
in pnut-ts (version forcing is source-tag-only, via {Spin2_vNN}, which this
file has never carried) and was removed as dead test code 2026-09-17. See
Test-Suite-Punch-List.md §6.6.

goldSource is pnut-ts. A hand-written fixture is pnut-ts when it uses a
preprocessor directive outside PNut's eight (suites.json pnutDirectives,
REF-V52A/p2com.asm:20094-20101), i.e. #include, #error, #warn, #pragma.

notes: Sourced from: src/tests/V52A-tests/pnut-ts-v52a.test.ts (glob *.spin2,
filters out *__pre.spin2). The pattern is the test's rule: files whose name
contains "debug" (case-insensitive substring) get -cd.
NOTE on drift: the legacy V52A-rebuild-v52/rebuild-gold.ps1 used -cd for
every file. The .test.ts substring rule (which the user has designated as
the source of truth) excludes 14 of 17 files from debug. If the existing
GOLDs were generated with -cd everywhere, regenerating under this rule
will produce different output for those 14 files. That diff is expected
and corrects the prior drift.

excluded.PREPROC-tests: PNut cannot produce this suite's GOLDs: every fixture's .pre.GOLD is PNut-TS -i output (PNut has no preprocessed-source output), the test passes per-file -D/-U/-I options PNut has no command-line form of, and its .errout.GOLDs come from #warn, which PNut does not have.
